phases.goal: Use exact-prompt VLA to control the red block and move it toward the blue pad.
phases.name: vla_establish_block_control
phases.verify: The block visibly moves with the robot and remains above or near the target support.

phases.goal: Continue short VLA corrections until the block is supported on the pad.
phases.name: vla_finish_supported_place
phases.verify: The block is on the blue pad and no unsupported handoff relation is assumed unless language requires it.

phases.goal: If the block is supported but the gripper remains closed, release only enough to clear it.
phases.name: minimal_final_release
phases.verify: The block stays on the pad after release and the gripper is clear.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: The phases are transferable guidance; the companion JSONL is one exact historical successful command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize from current observations; never replay clean coordinates from the companion trace.
critical_gates: The block visibly moves with the robot and remains above or near the target support.
The block is on the blue pad and no unsupported handoff relation is assumed unless language requires it.
The block stays on the pad after release and the gripper is clear.
strategy_notes.language_policy: Stored task_language is the historical clean source language. In new evaluation, the current episode task_language is authoritative; every new lingbot_act must use that complete current language rather than the clean prompt saved in JSONL.

task_language: Set the red block on the blue pad gently.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 4:release(arm=right). For every lingbot_act, use the current episode complete task_language; the stored clean prompt in the companion JSONL is historical evidence only. Relocalize from current observations and do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Do not invent a bimanual handoff when the current language only requires placing on the pad.
Extra release is useful only if the block is already supported and the gripper remains closed.
